sufficient_sets.text: In each cell of the human body, the human genome experiences, on average, tens of thousands of DNA damage events per day. These damage events can block genome replication or genome transcription, and if they are not repaired or are repaired incorrectly, they may lead to mutations, or other genome alterations in the human genome that threaten cell viability.
